label: Soft Pastel
description: Soft chalk pastel on a toned ground, with luminous layered color and velvety blended light; suited to tender and atmospheric scenes.
rendering: A finished soft-pastel painting of the work's world: strokes of chalk pastel layered and blended into glowing color, broken color in the lights and softened edges on distant forms.
palette: Luminous pastel color: peach and rose light, lavender shadows, warm ochres, sea greens and dusky blues, layered over a mid-tone ground.
lighting: Gentle, enveloping light, often at dawn or dusk; shadows carry color rather than black.
materials: Velvety pastel bloom, visible chalk strokes and blended passages within the scene; the toned ground shows only through the strokes, never as bare paper.
composition: Atmospheric, balanced staging with a clear focal subject; color carried fully to all four edges and corners.
negatives: The pastel covers the whole image: no bare paper margin, vignette into paper tone, border, tape mark or frame, and no signature, initials or caption. Avoid photorealism, hard graphic outlines and cartoon simplification.
